name: Handoff classifier — sample run
description: Made-up results for a fictional coffee subscription's support bot. The classifier answers one question: should this message go to a person? Each case was run 5 times.

cases.input: I've been charged twice this month and I want a refund now.
cases.note: Billing dispute with a direct request for a refund.

cases.input: How do I pause my subscription for two weeks?
cases.note: How-to question the bot can answer.

cases.input: Can I talk to a human please?
My order says delivered but it's not here.
cases.note: Missing delivery needs a person to check with the courier.

cases.input: What's the difference between the light and dark roast boxes?
This is the third time I've asked. Your bot keeps giving me the same useless answer.
cases.note: Repeated frustration. The bot should step aside.

cases.input: I'm a person who loves coffee. How do I change my grind size?
cases.note: Contains the word 'person' but isn't asking for one.

cases.input: Update my delivery address to 12 Example Street.
cases.note: Account change the bot can do.

cases.input: I think someone else is using my account.
cases.note: Possible account takeover. Always goes to a person.
